# Field guide theme

The September 2026 refresh puts the party before progress numbers, replaces the sidebar with Pokédex-red navigation, and uses cream paper, route scenery, local pixel sprites, and saved party HP bars. Existing route hashes, data and planning tools are preserved.

Sprites are generic National Dex species illustrations, not a representation of a Pokémon’s gender, shiny status or alternate form. 809 catalogued National Dex sprites are served locally; no roster is sent to a third-party image host. Source: https://github.com/PokeAPI/sprites, sprites/pokemon/{dexId}.png. See app/public/sprites/LICENSE.txt for upstream attribution; Pokémon characters belong to their respective rights holders. Route scenery and Poké Ball motifs are CSS.

Published release: eff96c9d-1c64-4d34-9b22-49fd958d76ce. Verified desktop and 390px mobile layout, zero page overflow, sprite loading, summary dialog, workshop and battle prep. All 14 existing parser/coaching tests passed. Production Camp shows nine loaded sprites with no broken images.
